title: The Small Bakery
author: Edmund Sandoval
blurb: Jonah Galloway, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
